name: Sharabutdin Magomedov
event: UFC Fight Night: Adesanya vs. Magomedov
summary: 'Shara Bullet' (17-1, age 32), a Dagestani middleweight from GOR MMA known for spinning attacks and flashy striking. He is 6-1 in the UFC; his only loss was a decision to Michael Page in February 2025. He has since won decisions over Marc-Andre Barriault and Michel Pereira. This is his first fight against a former champion.

how_they_fight.Striking: A kickboxer with spinning back kicks and fists, knees and a lot of feints. Twelve of his 17 wins are knockouts: seven in R1, three in R2 and two in R3 in our data.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Rarely wrestles (about 0.2 takedowns per 15 minutes in our data) and has never been submitted; he keeps fights standing.
how_they_fight.Defense: Never stopped. Page out-pointed him at range in his only loss.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: His last three wins all went the distance (Oleksiejczuk, Barriault, Pereira). He has never fought five rounds.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Patient when he can't find the finish; has struggled against a long, elusive counter-striker (Page).

patterns: Spinning kicks and fists, knees; most knockouts come early
Goes the distance against durable opponents (three of his last four)
concerns: Struggled against Michael Page's length and movement, a style Adesanya shares
Says he once put off an eye doctor visit before a rematch (Sherdog)
keys_to_beat: Stay long and make him reach; counter his entries
Take him into the later rounds

news.text: Says he rejected 100 million rubles to throw his 2024 fight with Michal Oleksiejczuk.
Money has come in on him: from about +170 to +130 (BetOnline).
